rationale: C11 plausibly supplied a substantial drafting template. The child follows the same commission-order architecture—establishment and composition, substantive study and recommendations, an Executive Director and staff, interagency cooperation, Emergency Fund financing, and a written final report—and reproduces especially distinctive language governing the Executive Director almost verbatim. C14 and C12 also closely parallel the survey, hearing, cooperation, reporting, and termination provisions, but neither matches the child's staffing machinery as comprehensively as C11.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established a Commission which shall be known as the President's Commission on Veterans' Pensions, and which shall be composed of a Chairman and six other members, all of whom shall be designated by the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established the Missouri Basin Survey Commission... The Commission shall be composed of eleven members who shall be appointed by the President. The President shall designate a chairman...
shared_material.explanation: Both begin with materially parallel provisions establishing and presidentially staffing a named commission.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There shall be an Executive Director of the Commission, who shall be appointed by the Chairman of the Commission after consultation with the other members of the Commission... Subject to the direction of the Chairman... the Executive Director shall direct the activities of all persons employed by the Commission, supervise the preparation of the report... and perform such other duties as the Chairman... shall designate.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There shall be an Executive Director of the Commission, who shall be appointed by the chairman of the Commission after consultation with the other members of the Commission... Subject to the direction of the chairman... the Executive Director shall direct the activities of all persons employed under the Commission, shall supervise the preparation of reports... and shall perform such other duties... as the chairman... shall designate.
shared_material.explanation: This lengthy, distinctive staffing provision is nearly verbatim and strongly indicates direct reuse.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance, not inconsistent with law, as it may require in the performance of its functions.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All departments and other agencies of the Executive branch of the Government... are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance, not inconsistent with law, as it may require for the performance of its duties.
shared_material.explanation: The cooperation clause closely tracks C11 within the same sequence of commission machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The expenditures of the Commission shall be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation entitled "Emergency Fund for the President—National Defense"... Such payments shall be made without regard to the following: section 3681... section 9... and such other laws as the President may hereafter specify.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The expenditures of the Commission shall be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation entitled "Emergency Fund for the President-National Defense"... Such payments shall be made without regard to the following: section 3681... section 9... and such other laws as the President may hereafter specify.
shared_material.explanation: The financing mechanism and enumerated statutory exceptions are reproduced with only appropriation-year updates.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Commission shall make a final written report, including findings and recommendations, to the President... The Commission may also make such earlier progress reports to the President as it may deem appropriate.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Commission shall report to the President, in writing... the results of its studies and its recommendations... The Commission may also make to the President such earlier report or reports as it may deem appropriate.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the machinery with materially parallel final and interim reporting requirements.
